pairs: After the blood of the guilty was shed,
and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest:
Numerate omnem summam filiorum Israël a viginti annis et supra,
“Number the entire sum of the sons of Israel, from twenty years and above,
cunctos qui possunt ad bella procedere.
all who are able to go forth to war.”
Locuti sunt itaque Moyses et Eleazar sacerdos,
And so, Moses and Eleazar the priest,
in campestribus Moab super Jordanem contra Jericho,
who were in the plains of Moab, above the Jordan, opposite Jericho,
just as the Lord had commanded.
from whom is the family of the Hanochites;
from whom is the family of the Palluites;
from whom is the family of the Hezronites;
from whom is the family of the Carmites.
Hæ sunt familiæ de stirpe Ruben:
These are the families of the stock of Ruben,
quarum numerus inventus est quadraginta tria millia,
whose number was found to be forty-three thousand
isti sunt Dathan et Abiron principes populi,
These are Dathan and Abiram, the leaders of the people,
qui surrexerunt contra Moysen et Aaron in seditione Core,
who rose up against Moses and Aaron in the sedition at Korah,
when they rebelled against the Lord.
et aperiens terra os suum devoravit Core,
And the earth, opening its mouth, devoured Korah,
quando combussit ignis ducentos quinquaginta viros.
when the fire burned two hundred fifty men.
And a great miracle was wrought,
The sons of Simeon, by their kinships: Nemuel,
from him is the family of the Nemuelites; Jamin,
from him is the family of the Jaminites;
from him is the family of the Jachinites;
from him is the family of the Soharites;
from him is the family of the Shaulites.
Hæ sunt familiæ de stirpe Simeon,
These are the families of the stock of Simeon,
quarum omnis numerus fuit viginti duo millia ducenti.
whose entire number was twenty-two thousand two hundred.
The sons of Gad, by their kinships:
Zephon, from him is the family of the Zephonites;
from him is the family of the Haggites;
from him is the family of the Shunites;
from him is the family of the Oznites;
from him is the family of the Erites;
from him is the family of the Arodites;
from him is the family of the Arelites.
These are the families of Gad,
quarum omnis numerus fuit quadraginta millia quingenti.
whose entire number was forty thousand five hundred.
qui ambo mortui sunt in terra Chanaan.
who both died in the land of Canaan.
Fueruntque filii Juda per cognationes suas:
And these were the sons of Judah, by their kinships:
from whom is the family of the Shelahites; Perez,
from whom is the family of the Perezites;
from whom is the family of the Zerahites.
Moreover, the sons of Phares were:
Hezron, from whom is the family of the Hezronites;
from whom is the family of the Hamulites.
These are the families of Judah,
quarum omnis numerus fuit septuaginta sex millia quingenti.
whose entire number was seventy-six thousand five hundred.
Tola from whom is the family of the Tolaites;
from whom is the family of the Puvahites;
from whom is the family of the Jashubites;
from whom is the family of the Shimronites.
These are the kinships of Issachar,
quarum numerus fuit sexaginta quatuor millia trecenti.
whose number was sixty-four thousand three hundred.
The sons of Zebulon by their kinships:
from whom is the family of the Seredites;
from whom is the family of the Elonites;
from whom is the family of the Jahleelites.
These are the kinships of Zebulun,
quarum numerus fuit sexaginta millia quingenti.
whose number was sixty thousand five hundred.
The sons of Joseph by their kinships:
from whom is the family of the Machirites.
from whom is the family of the Gileadites.
from whom is the family of the Jezerites;
from whom is the family of the Helekites;
from whom is the family of the Asrielites;
from whom is the family of the Shechemites;
from whom is the family of the Shemidaites;
from whom is the family of the Hepherites.
Now Hepher was the father of Zelophehad,
These are the families of Manasseh,
et numerus earum quinquaginta duo millia septingenti.
and their number was fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
Filii autem Ephraim per cognationes suas fuerunt hi:
Now the sons of Ephraim by their kinships were these:
from whom is the family of the Shuthelahites;
from whom is the family of the Becherites;
from whom is the family of the Tahanites.
Furthermore, the son of Shuthelah was Eran,
from whom is the family of the Eranites.
These are the kinships of the sons of Ephraim,
quarum numerus fuit triginta duo millia quingenti.
whose number was thirty-two thousand five hundred.
Isti sunt filii Joseph per familias suas.
These are the sons of Joseph by their families:
the sons of Benjamin in their kinships:
from whom is the family of the Belaites;
from whom is the family of the Ashbelites;
from whom is the family of the Ahiramites;
from whom is the family of the Shuphamites;
from whom is the family of the Huphamites.
Hi sunt filii Benjamin per cognationes suas:
These are the sons of Benjamin by their kinships,
quorum numerus fuit quadraginta quinque millia sexcenti.
whose number was forty-five thousand six hundred.
The sons of Dan by their kinships:
from whom is the family of the Shuhamites.
Hæ sunt cognationes Dan per familias suas.
These are the kinships of Dan by their families.
quorum numerus erat sexaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.
whose number was sixty-four thousand four hundred.
The sons of Asher by their kinships:
from whom is the family of the Imnahites;
from whom is the family of the Ishvites;
from whom is the family of the Beriahites.
from whom is the family of the Heberites;
from whom is the family of the Malchielites.
Nomen autem filiæ Aser fuit Sara.
Now the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
These are the kinships of the sons of Asher,
et numerus eorum quinquaginta tria millia quadringenti.
and their number was fifty-three thousand four hundred.
The sons of Naphtali by their kinships:
from whom is the family of the Jahzeelites;
from whom is the family of the Gunites;
from whom is the family of the Jezerites;
from whom is the family of the Shillemites.
Hæ sunt cognationes filiorum Nephthali per familias suas:
These are the kinships of the sons of Naphtali by their families,
quorum numerus quadraginta quinque millia quadringenti.
whose number was forty-five thousand four hundred.
This is the sum of the sons of Israel,
and one thousand seven hundred thirty.
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Istis dividetur terra juxta numerum vocabulorum in possessiones suas.
“The land shall be divided to these, as their possessions, according to the number of their names.
To the greater number you shall give a greater portion,
and to the lesser number, a lesser portion.
just as they have now been counted,
ita dumtaxat ut sors terram tribubus dividat et familiis.
Yet only in so far as the land is divided by lot to a tribe and to families.
Whatever the lot will happen to be,
Hic quoque est numerus filiorum Levi per familias suas:
Likewise, this is the number of the sons of Levi by their families:
from whom is the family of the Gershonites;
from whom is the family of the Kohathites; Merari,
from whom is the family of the Merarites.
These are the families of Levi:
qui habuit uxorem Jochabed filiam Levi,
who had a wife, Jochebed, the daughter of Levi,
quæ nata est ei in Ægypto.
who was born to him in Egypt.
Hæc genuit Amram viro suo filios,
She bore, to her husband Amram: sons,
as well as their sister, Miriam.
De Aaron orti sunt Nadab et Abiu,
From Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu,
cum obtulissent ignem alienum coram Domino.
when they had offered strange fire before the Lord.
And these were all who were numbered:
viginti tria millia generis masculini ab uno mense
twenty-three thousand of the male gender,
quia non sunt recensiti inter filios Israël,
For they were not counted among the sons of Israel,
nec eis cum ceteris data possessio est.
neither was a possession given to them with the others.
This is the number of the sons of Israel,
qui descripti sunt a Moyse et Eleazaro sacerdote,
who were enrolled by Moses and by Eleazar the priest,
in campestribus Moab supra Jordanem contra Jericho:
in the plains of Moab, above the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
nullus fuit eorum qui ante numerati sunt a Moyse
not one of them was numbered before,
by Moses and Aaron in the desert of Sinai.
prædixerat enim Dominus quod omnes morerentur in solitudine.
For the Lord had foretold that all would die in the wilderness.
And not one of them remained,
except Caleb the son of Jephunneh,
and Joshua the son of Nun.
